highlights: 接口测试支持比例、1K/2K及常用/自定义分辨率目标，多张参考图、音频及视频素材，图生图共用同一有序素材接口；实际像素仍以上游成品为准。
账号卡片精简为额度、状态和必要操作，全部刷新统一检查额度/会话/实际Cookie有效期，临期会话自动提前维护，保留失败和忙碌结果。
请求与日志明确记录映射账号、标签和尝试序号，生成准备失败和换号重试也保留可追溯信息。
移除媒体库页签，任务详情统一在线预览图片/视频/音频并显示生成参数、账号及安全错误；已清理媒体明确提示，历史无请求文件索引不伪造账号。
扩展仍为1.0.2、油猴脚本1.1.2，当前无需重装；旧版仍需手动在每个浏览器个人资料升级。
highlights_en: The test studio supports aspect ratios, 1K/2K and common/custom pixel targets, ordered multi-image/audio/video references and image-to-image; actual media dimensions depend on upstream results.
Compact account cards use unified refresh for quota/session/cookie metadata, with proactive near-expiry checks and truthful busy/failure states.
Requests and diagnostics retain assigned account IDs/labels and retry attempts, including preparation failures before generation starts.

Removed the media-library tab; task details preview images/video/audio with request targets, account and safe errors. Missing media is explicit; legacy files are indexed without inventing request identities.
Extension remains 1.0.2 and userscript 1.1.2; older versions still need a manual upgrade in every browser profile.
